title: Patch: determinize samples each side's hidden cards against that side's shown cards
thread:
**Issue #2826 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2826: Patch: determinize samples each side's hidden cards against that side's shown cards
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
To decide, the practice opponent imagines the hidden cards by dealing them from the catalog minus the cards already seen. Today it uses one shared seen-list built only from the opponent's shown cards, even when guessing its own future draws. After the fix, each side's hidden cards are guessed against what that side has shown. Example: in a one-copy deck, the AI stops imagining a future draw of a card that is already sitting on its own board.
## Why
`det_ground` in `crates/ai/src/determinize.rs` builds a single `seen` set from cards owned by the opponent only, and step 5 samples the seat's own library placeholders against that same set. Two skews follow: the seat's own visible cards are never excluded from its own library sampling, so a world can hold two copies of a card the seat already shows, impossible under one copy per deck (SPEC §2.6, `MAX_COPIES`); and opponent-shown cards are wrongly excluded from the seat's own library, though one seat's shuffle says nothing about the other's. Adjacent to #2811 (own-deck redaction in `redact`) but a different file and mechanism: that one fixed what the seat is shown, this one fixes what it imagines.
## Proposal
Build per-side seen sets (opponent-visible for opponent zones, seat-visible for the seat's own library) in `det_ground` and sample each zone against its side's set in steps 4 and 5, keeping the rng stream order so determinism is preserved. Pure function of public state plus rng, as today.
## Where it lands
Files: `crates/ai/src/determinize.rs` (`det_ground`, `determinize` steps 4 and 5, `sample_def`). SPEC sections: §9.9 and R185 (determinization), §2.6 (one copy per deck).
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] New determinize tests: a placeholder never samples a def id its own side already shows (one-copy invariant), and the seat's library may still sample an id only the opponent showed.
- [ ] Existing determinize suites (shown-cost, aura, traps) pass unchanged.
- [ ] AI gate holds its floors at smoke size.
## Size and risks
Small work, suggested `difficulty:hard` (AI internals). Risk is low: the change is local to sampling pools, and hashes moving slightly is expected and covered by the gate.
```
